Subject: Offer band exception request — Sr. Runtime Engineer (Maria Solis)

Team,

Quick summary: Maria Solis (final candidate for Sr. Runtime Engineer, req HR-REQ-9876) has accepted a counteroffer from a stealth infra startup that is $25k above our top of band. She's excited about Redwood and the role (runtime optimizations, kernel work), and has told the recruiter she prefers our team, but needs parity to make the move.

Why I am asking for an exception:
- Mission-critical hire: Maria would lead our low-latency kernel efforts and unblock a Q3 latency milestone.
- Hard-to-replace skill set: compiler/runtime + CUDA/ML kernels; strong open-source profile.
- Speed: candidate expects a signed offer within 48 hours or she'll go with the competitor.

Proposed exception: bump base + sign-on package to get to $25k above top-of-band for a single-cycle exception (no promotion band change; documented as one-off). Total comp impact is forecasted in the attached comp_worksheet.xlsx. I also attached a short memo for comp committee context (comp_committee_memo.docx).

Asks:
1) Kimberly — can you sign off for an exception if the finance check passes?
2) Marcus — can you confirm impact to team comp budget and whether we can fast-track approval?
3) Soojin — would you be willing to approve this exception so we can extend the offer today?

I’ve looped in the recruiter (Rachel) for visibility; she has the competing offer screenshot and candidate expectations.

Thanks — short turnaround on this one.

— Logan
Logan Wright
